name: plan-competition-ideas
title_zh: 赛题挖出可落地MVP，先验AI契合度再动手
tagline_zh: 投比赛最怕点子大而空。这个技能把题目拆成可验证的最小产品，先查AI能不能做、别人做过没。
tagline_en: Stop pitching vague ideas. This skill breaks contest prompts into a testable MVP, checks AI feasibility & prior.
desc_en: Develop competition problems and ideas into a bounded, differentiated MVP. Use for 공모전기획, 문제채굴 or 차별화검증, including AI fit and prior-art strategy.
why_zh: 它把「差异化」从口号变成流程：先挖问题边界，再强制过AI契合与先例检索两道闸。
why_en: It turns 'differentiation' from buzzword into a pipeline: problem scoping → AI-fit gate → prior-art check, outputting a testable.
limit_zh: 只服务「竞赛方案策划」这一格：输入得是赛题或点子，不接产品迭代。产出是MVP定义与验证清单，不含代码。
limit_en: Only for contest ideation: takes a prompt or idea, outputs MVP spec & validation checklist. No code, prototype, or biz plan. Prior-art search uses.
title_en: Turn contest prompts into a bounded MVP, AI-fit checked.
